01
Golden Gloves

Home of the Golden Gloves.

Dixon’s hosts the South Island Golden Gloves — one of New Zealand boxing’s great nights. Fighters from across the South Island come to Richmond to test themselves under these lights.

GOLDEN GLOVESSouth Island · Richmond

“Train. Learn. Spar. Improve. Belong.”

That’s the Dixon’s way — five words that run through everything the club does, from a first-timer’s first session to fight night.

The club also runs Fight for Rangatahi events, giving young people a stage, a goal and a team behind them — and regular open sparring, where boxers from other clubs come to Richmond to sharpen up.

Whether you want to compete, get fit, or just learn the sweet science properly, there’s a place for you here.
